book.name: Akaaefeso
book.title: Lihamba lya Paulo kwa bhandu bha Kuefeso

content: Paulo kangualandamila bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi
Kubhukana na agha, nenga Paulo mmopwa kwakya Kilisto Yesu, nungaayupila kwakya mwenga bhandu mumbheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi kwa Chapanga.
Kulyaghila, nnyihwa kala kukita, Chapanga kwa umaha ghwake, kambegha lihegho ali nilitende kwakya kuatangatila mwenga.
Chapanga kakihughulila nenga mpangilo ghwake na kundenda manye nnando ghwangamanyikwa kwa bhandu bhangi. Na nenga ndyeka kwa uhupitaho nhalo aghu,
na mwenga pamusoma maha malagho ghanughatyekite, mahotola kumanya bhula nenga mumanyite mpangilo ghwa maha ghwa Kilisto.
Bhandu bha makachu bhakighombelwa ng'obhe lupwepo alu, peni hinu Chapanga kabhatenda andumila na ambuye bhake ang'anyimo bhamanye lupwepo alu kwa njila ya Nhuki ywake.

Lupwepo lwene ndo alu, kupitila Nhalo ghwa Maha, bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi bhaamokola lifungu lyabhe papamu na Ayahudi bhoha yila nonelo hya Chapanga, bhombe ndo hibhungo hya mmili ghumu, na bhangulihanga na naghilo yilayila yakayitendite Chapanga kwa njila ya Kilisto Yesu.
Nenga ndendwa meghe nunndumitumi ghwa Nhalo ghwa Maha kwa luhungu lwa kighweka luumbeghitwe na Chapanga kwa makakala ghake makulu.
Nenga ndo nndokwa kupitingana bhandu bhoha bha Chapanga. Peni Chapanga kakimbegha umaha ghwake ili nualandamihe bhandu bhaabheghite ng'obhe Ayahudi ukulu aghu ghuubheghite nkati mwa Kilisto,
Bhubho Chapanga ndo kakimbegha na kuatenda bhandu bhoha bhamanye nnando aghu ghuubheghite ghwangamanyikwa kwa manjubha ghoha gha Chapanga ywakabhumbite hilibhi hyoha,

Peni hinu Chapanga kangupala bhandu bhoha bhaanhyubhalila Kilisto bhannangihe kila mundu bhula pakabheghite na malango kwa njila yohele. Kangupala hilongohi bhaabheghite mu nnima ghwangabhonekana na hilongohi bha kunani bhamanye agho.
Chapanga kakitenda nnando aghwo kulandana na mpangilo ghwake na kakitenda kwa njila ya Kilisto Yesu Bambo ghwetu.
Basi, kwa kulilunga na Kilisto kwa njila ya kunhyubhalila, twenga tunguhotola kunng'endela Chapaanga kwa ukangamalo kyangayoghopa.
Kya habhu, nunguayupa nkotoke kutunyuka mwoyo, kubhukana na mapungwo ghangu kwakya kuatangatila mwenga, mana agho ndo kwakya uhokamo ghwenu.
Upalo ghwa Kilisto.
Kubhukana na mpangilo aghu ghwa Tate, nungunchutamila mayughwa Tate panuayupila mwenga,
ywakabheghite kitandilo kya hilibhi hyoha hya munnima na hya kunane, hyoha hingubhukana na ywombe.
Nungunnyupa Chapanga kabhatengelehe kwa kuapegha makakala ngenju mu myoyo yenu kubhukana na utangalo ghwa ukulu ghwake,

ili Kilisto katame mu myoyo yenu kwa kuhyubhalila. Kangi nungunnyupa kabhatangatile mmanye maha upalo ghwa Chapanga. Na mwenga maabhegha handa mikongo yiibheghite na ngigha yiidibala kyanalumu mu upalo ghwa Chapanga, ayi yatutenda tubhegha na makakala.
Likaho nhotole kumanya papamu na bhandu bhoha bha Chapanga kya bhula Kilisto kakitupala muno kwa upalo ghwanga uhiko
nunguyupa mmokole kumanya upalo aghwo payibhele yinguhotoleka ng'obhe kumanyikwa kyanalumu bhula mughubheghite nkulu, apo ndo matamilo ghenu paghapala kulandana na Chapanga.
Basi, tuntike Chapanga ywakahotola kutenda milando ngenju ya kukangahya kupitingana kwa ghala ghatughayupa ebu ghatughahwacha telatela na makakala ghake ghanakutenda lihengo nkati mwetu.
Tungupala bhandu bhoha bhaanhyubhalila Kilisto bhamanye kukita Chapanga ndo nkulu numbe Chapanga mu Ngwemuko ya bhandu bhaannyubhalila Kilisto, na mu Yesu manjubha ghoha! Mwika.
